$comment: Shared LLM provider error taxonomy, decided in danieljustus/symaira-corekit#172. Consumers map these to exitcodes values; they must not string-match provider-specific error text.

errors.meaning: Provider rejected the request for rate limiting (HTTP 429). Carries retry_after when the provider reports one.
Prompt exceeds the model's context window (HTTP 400 with overflow signature).
Requested model/deployment does not exist for this credential (HTTP 404 or equivalent body).
Network-level failure: connection refused/reset, DNS, TLS, timeout. Local-first setups hit this whenever a local endpoint is down.
Any provider-reported failure that fits no more specific category. Carries the upstream status and body excerpt.
